ja205:1.1: sobhati maccho gaṅgeyyo → sobhanti macchā gaṅgeyyā (sya-all) | sobhati → sobhanti macchā (bj: sī); gaṅgeyyā atho sobhanti yamunā (bj: syā)

ja205:2.1: na → naṁ (bj) | akkhāsi → akkhā (sya-all) | akkhāsi → akkhā (cck: sī. syā. pī.)
ja205:2.2: akkhāsi → akkhāti (sya-all) | akkhāti → akkhāti (bj: a.jā) | akkhāsi → akkhāti (cck: syā. pī.)
